home.heroTitle: A quiet space in a noisy world.
home.heroSub: Train your attention gently, check in with yourself, and watch your focus grow over time. No pressure, no streaks—just a few minutes to come back to yourself.
home.introTitle: Come see why attention training is the quietest form of self-care.
home.introSub: Just as a spa visit restores the body, a few minutes of focused attention restores the mind. Focus Machine is your private space to pause, notice, and gently train your ability to stay present.
home.checkinSub: How are you feeling right now? No judgment. Just notice.
home.quietSub: Like a meditation room or a quiet corner of a spa, Focus Machine gives your attention a place to rest. No streaks. No pressure. Just a few minutes of gentle practice.
home.readySub: Take a few minutes today to build a calmer, more focused you.

about.title: The quietest form of self-care.
about.subtitle: Focus Machine is a continuous, self-paced visual training tool designed to help you bring your attention back to the present moment. It’s not a medical treatment—it’s simply a calm, honest space to notice your mind and train your focus.
about.readySub: Take a few minutes today to build a calmer, more focused you.
